sentences.text: Natasha Jane Richardson -LRB- 11 May 1963 -- 18 March 2009 -RRB- was an English stage and screen actress .
Richardson was a member of the Redgrave family .	Redgrave family	Redgrave family

She was the daughter of actress Vanessa Redgrave and director/producer Tony Richardson and the granddaughter of Michael Redgrave and Rachel Kempson .	Tony Richardson	Tony Richardson	Vanessa Redgrave	Vanessa Redgrave	Michael Redgrave	Michael Redgrave	Rachel Kempson	Rachel Kempson

Early in her career , she portrayed Mary Shelley in Ken Russell 's Gothic -LRB- 1986 -RRB- , and Patty Hearst in the eponymous 1988 film directed by Paul Schrader , and later received critical acclaim and a Theatre World Award for her Broadway debut in the 1993 revival of Anna Christie .
